# Package license files omitted from release archives

The SBOM generator uses a package's installed license files first. This tree
preserves upstream notices for the exact package releases whose published
archives omit them. Paths follow `<ecosystem>/<package>/<version>/<file>`.
Generation reads these files locally.

| Packages                                        | Upstream revision containing the notice                                                                                     |
| ----------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Solid and Solid Web 2.0.0-rc.20                 | [solidjs/solid](https://github.com/solidjs/solid/tree/5e68925cc2fd216a9fb06345019e66d5da5c523c)                             |
| Drizzle ORM 0.45.4                              | [drizzle-team/drizzle-orm](https://github.com/drizzle-team/drizzle-orm/tree/eab8bedbb65d5429c54e612ddbd88aa23091d398)       |
| gloo-net 0.7.0                                  | [rustwasm/gloo](https://github.com/rustwasm/gloo/tree/d69fcff62ee63f37076c4a0715a6f828b0036599)                             |
| gloo-timers 0.4.0                               | [rustwasm/gloo](https://github.com/rustwasm/gloo/tree/c8feeb18bf5dde6b7aed80c749e1aef89b34fb52)                             |
| gloo-utils 0.3.0                                | [rustwasm/gloo](https://github.com/rustwasm/gloo/tree/e6280d4b93c86a478a8f2f31af5f13d770b156b7)                             |
| profiling 1.0.18                                | [aclysma/profiling](https://github.com/aclysma/profiling/tree/8271551172eb6fa4cba47369aedd93790c623df9)                     |
| rusty_h264-common and rusty_h264-encoder 0.17.0 | [remade-with-rust/rusty_h264](https://github.com/remade-with-rust/rusty_h264/tree/c6bd1b6be8d1c29aa08ab2f53b19ba1cbbb209a4) |
